errors.text_span: of various Large Language Models (LLMs) in the EBS-AOS pattern
errors.evidence: This information is taken from the paper's caption, not the figure itself. The figure does not provide any labels on the x-axis or a legend to identify what the bars represent.
The chart clearly displays twelve bars, not ten.
The description claims each bar represents an LLM, but this is an assumption from the paper's caption. The figure itself does not contain any information to support this claim.
The description fails to mention that the horizontal axis is unlabeled, which is a significant omission regarding the chart's structure and content.
